hausa_text: Da wasa ake fadawa wawa magana.
english_translation: A word is enough for the wise.
meaning_note: The wise need not be told twice; a single word suffices for understanding.

hausa_text: Zaman duniya iyawa ne.
english_translation: An expert driver can also last long.
meaning_note: Skill and patience lead to endurance in life's journey.

hausa_text: Dan'uwa rabin jiki.
english_translation: Blood is thicker than water.
meaning_note: Family bonds are stronger than any other relationship.

hausa_text: Mugu yasan makwantar mugu.
english_translation: Set a thief to catch a thief.
meaning_note: One who knows wrongdoing can best identify it in others.

hausa_text: Komai nisan jifa kasa zai fado.
english_translation: Whatever goes up must come down.
meaning_note: All things in life are subject to change and return to their origin.

hausa_text: Gida biyu maganin gobara.
english_translation: Having two homes provides protection against fire.
meaning_note: Do not put all your eggs in one basket; diversify your options.

hausa_text: Hana wani, hana kai.
english_translation: If one refuses another, one refuses oneself.
meaning_note: Rejecting help to others ultimately harms yourself.

hausa_text: Hakuri maganin duniya.
english_translation: Patience is the world's medicine.
meaning_note: Patience heals all troubles and brings peace.

hausa_text: Mai hakuri ya kan dafa dutse ya sha romonsa.
english_translation: A patient person will cook a stone and drink its broth.
meaning_note: With enough patience, even the impossible becomes possible.

hausa_text: Sannu ba ta hana zuwa, in ji kunkuru.
english_translation: Travelling slowly doesn't keep one from arriving, says the tortoise.
meaning_note: Slow but steady progress will eventually reach the goal.

hausa_text: Yau da shi ya sa allura ginin rijiya.
english_translation: Doing a thing little by little made it possible for the needle to dig a well.
meaning_note: Perseverance wins out; small efforts accumulate into great achievements.

hausa_text: Rigakafi ya fi magani.
english_translation: A preventative is better than a medicine.
meaning_note: Prevention is better than cure.

hausa_text: Zumunta a kafa ta ke.
english_translation: Good relationships depend upon feet.
meaning_note: Maintaining relationships requires frequent visiting and presence.

hausa_text: Alla ya ce, Tashi in taimaka ka.
english_translation: God says, Get up, and then let me help you.
meaning_note: God helps those who help themselves.

hausa_text: Kwadayi mabudin wahala.
english_translation: Greed is the key path to trouble.
meaning_note: Greed opens the door to suffering and problems.

hausa_text: Kowa ya ji haushi, ya ji da kansa.
english_translation: Whoever feels anger, feels it with themselves.
meaning_note: Anger hurts the person who holds it more than anyone else.

hausa_text: Karamin sani, kamar karamin wuta.
english_translation: A little knowledge is like a small fire.
meaning_note: Partial knowledge can be dangerous if misused.

hausa_text: Hakuri yakan fi karfi.
english_translation: Patience is stronger than force.
meaning_note: Patience achieves more than aggression.

hausa_text: Kowa ya shuka, shi ya girbi.
english_translation: Whoever plants, harvests.
meaning_note: You reap what you sow.

hausa_text: Gidan da ba shi da kunya, ba shi da mutunci.
english_translation: A house without shame has no honor.
meaning_note: Without modesty, there can be no true dignity.

hausa_text: Karya a ke ji, amma gaskiya a ke gani.
english_translation: Lies are heard, but truth is seen.
meaning_note: Truth reveals itself through actions, not words.

hausa_text: Mai ci da uwa ba shi kukan suɗi.
english_translation: The one who eats with mother does not cry for hunger.
meaning_note: A child raised with care and love will not suffer.

hausa_text: Ruwa ba su tsami banza.
english_translation: Water does not waste its foam.
meaning_note: Nothing in nature is without purpose.

hausa_text: Makaho ya rasa ido, ya ce ido na wari.
english_translation: The blind man lost his eye, and he said the other eye stinks.
meaning_note: People often devalue what they no longer have.

hausa_text: Kunkuru yana son dambe, ba shi da yatsa.
english_translation: The tortoise wants to wrestle, but has no fingers.
meaning_note: Be careful of those who boast but lack the ability to deliver.

hausa_text: Ba don rigan domin ba, da mutum ya mutu matsyaci.
english_translation: If not for 'because of', a man would die poor.
meaning_note: Every person has a reason for their circumstances.

hausa_text: Fawa biyu tana ɓata hankalin ƙuda.
english_translation: Two heads confuse the judgment of a simpleton.
meaning_note: Too many opinions can cloud decision-making.

hausa_text: Mai akuya ya yi tafiya dare, balle mai kura.
english_translation: A goat travels at night, how much more a hyena.
meaning_note: If the weak can endure hardship, the strong certainly can.

hausa_text: Da na sani kyeya ce.
english_translation: If I had only known is like the back of one's head.
meaning_note: Regret is useless; what's done is done.

hausa_text: Kayan sammako, da maraice a kan daure shi.
english_translation: Loads prepared for early morning start are tied the previous evening.
meaning_note: Forewarned is forearmed.

hausa_text: Kome ka yi, ka nemi abin kanka.
english_translation: Whatever you do, look after your own needs.
meaning_note: Depend on yourself; don't sponge off others.

hausa_text: Ramin mugunta a gina shi gajere.
english_translation: Dig a pit of evil shallow.
meaning_note: Be careful not to be caught in your own trap.

hausa_text: Tusa ba ta hura wuta.
english_translation: Breaking wind won't bring a dormant fire to flame.
meaning_note: Don't depend on someone or something that can't do the job.

hausa_text: Barin kashi a ciki ba ya maganin yunwa.
english_translation: Keeping one's excrement in one's stomach doesn't keep one from hunger.
meaning_note: Speak out when the time comes; remaining silent won't solve the problem.

hausa_text: Da yayafi kogi kan cika.
english_translation: By means of drizzles a river fills up.
meaning_note: Persistence pays off; small efforts lead to big results.

hausa_text: Yau da gobe ka iya.
english_translation: Today and tomorrow, little by little you will be able.
meaning_note: Little by little one can accomplish a thing.
